shortDescription: Some large cargo ships paid up to $5 million this summer in near-term auctions to cross the Panama Canal. "How the Panama Canal Became a 50-Mile Waterway With a $5 Million Ticket Price - WSJ" at 7 p.m. ET on Sept. 23 incorrectly implied $5 million was the cost to cross the canal.
